content.title: The Editor Jam Has Been PostPoned!

content.body:
[img](https://github.com/Cleo876/wasm-video-editor/blob/main/IMGs/Meta-Data/PostPoned_Editor-Jam.png?raw=true) [right] Unfortunately, we had to postpone the event, due to the original filming crew being unavailable to shoot the footage for us, and us not being able to procure another team in the time period we were hoping for. SO as a result, we are going to postpone the event until we can make proper adjustments for it to work excellently.

In the meantime! We are still working on, and upgrading the **WASM Video Editor** to raise the bar for the level of power and capabilities we put at your fingertips as users.

1. As of **August 13, 2026** we have released **v2.10.0** and it has some upgrades that are worth noting! Such as us increasing the efficiency of the **Realtime Webm Exporter** with having the ability to export **Full length movies!**

Instead of storing the video chunks in the RAM, we opted to write the chunks straight into the IndexedDB for holding until all of the chunks for the video are exported, this has allowed for a trimendous reduction in the CPU throttling and has allowed for a greater optimization of the exporting power that comes with this.

The other upgrade we made was to ensure that the audio would be muted during the realtime export so you didn't have to keep hearing the audio for the entire export time.

We are now able to present the upgraded **WASM Video Editor - Ghost App Installer** complete with the **Hardware Acceleration** enabled! This means that we can now see better performance on older computers as it uses less CPU power by utilizing greater GPU power to balance out the load!

Download the new version **[here](https://cleo876.github.io/wasm-video-editor/landing.html#download)** **WASM Video Editor** [img](https://github.com/Cleo876/wasm-video-editor/blob/main/IMGs/Banners/WASM%20Cinematic%20Wallpaper%203.png?raw=true) [right]
